ce_bugs.text: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Legacy host values are interpolated unescaped into SQL, so a quote in the setting can break or alter the migration.
app/models/embeddable_host.rb:14 — URI parsing drops the request port while stored hosts retain allowed ports, making every port-specific allowlist entry silently deny embeds.
app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — Duplicate hosts are permitted and an unordered first match selects their category nondeterministically, allowing concurrent edits to misroute embedded topics.

config/routes.rb:153 — The unrestricted resource declaration publishes index and show routes that the controller does not implement, so those advertised REST endpoints fail instead of returning a defined response.

db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:11 — The migration dereferences the first embed_category row even when the default setting has no database row, so upgrades can abort with a nil error.
app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — Lookup discards the request port while stored hosts retain configured ports, making every allowed host with a port impossible to match.
db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:11 — Missing embed_category rows make the migration dereference nil before its fallback can run.
db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:25 — Raw host values are interpolated into SQL, so a stored quote can abort the backfill and deployment.
app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:10 — Updating a nonexistent host passes nil into save_host and raises a 500 instead of returning a not-found response.
app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:16 — Deleting a nonexistent host calls destroy on nil and raises a 500 instead of returning a not-found response.
app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6:46 — A failed delete leaves an unhandled promise rejection and gives the administrator no error feedback.
db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:27 — Interpolating the persisted embeddable-host setting directly into INSERT SQL enables stored SQL injection during migration.
